projectInfo.description: A standalone migration utility tool that converts iBATIS 2 configuration files and DAO implementations to MyBatis 3 format.

dependencies.notes: Used for parsing and writing XML files (iBATIS/MyBatis config and mapper files)

issues.title: Java 8 End of Life (Extended Support)
issues.description: The project targets Java 8 (source and target in pom.xml). Java 8 reached end of public updates. Upgrading to Java 17 LTS or Java 21 LTS is strongly recommended for long-term support, security patches, and modern language features.
issues.recommendation: Update maven-compiler-plugin source/target from '8' to '17' or '21' and test compatibility.

issues.title: No dependency version management (BOM/dependencyManagement)
issues.description: The pom.xml declares a single direct dependency (dom4j 2.1.3) without a parent BOM or dependencyManagement section. This can lead to version drift in larger projects.
issues.recommendation: Consider adding a dependencyManagement section or using a BOM for consistent dependency versioning.

issues.title: Swallowed exceptions using getStackTrace()
issues.description: Multiple catch blocks call e.getStackTrace() (which returns an array but does not print it) instead of e.printStackTrace() or proper logging. This silently discards error detail.
issues.recommendation: Replace e.getStackTrace() with e.printStackTrace() or a logging framework (e.g., SLF4J + Logback).

issues.title: File I/O resources not managed with try-with-resources
issues.description: FileReader, BufferedReader, FileWriter, and XMLWriter instances are closed manually in sequential calls. If an exception occurs before close(), resources may leak. Java 7+ try-with-resources should be used.
issues.recommendation: Refactor file I/O blocks to use try-with-resources to guarantee resource closure.

issues.title: No unit tests present
issues.description: The project contains no test sources (src/test/java is absent). There are no JUnit or other test framework dependencies. The migration logic (regex patterns, XML transformations) is untested.
issues.recommendation: Add JUnit 5 (or JUnit 4) dependency and create unit tests for convertDaoImpl, convertConfigXML, and convertSqlMapXML methods.

cloudReadiness.notes: This is a command-line batch processing tool with no server, no database connections, and no external service calls. It reads/writes local files. It is inherently stateless and can be containerized easily, but requires volume mounts for input/output file access.

migrationRecommendations: Upgrade Java version from 8 to 17 or 21 LTS
Add proper logging (SLF4J + Logback) to replace System.out.println and fix swallowed exceptions
Refactor file I/O to use try-with-resources
Add unit tests to validate XML transformation and regex pattern logic
Consider adding a CLI framework (e.g., picocli) for a more robust command-line interface
